title: Up-elbow bound conjecture for bumpless pipe dreams
statement: Let $\omega$ be a permutation, and let $P\in\operatorname{Pipes}(\omega)$. If $P$ is non-reduced, replace the redundant crossings with bump tiles. **Up-elbow bound conjecture.** Pipe $i$ has at most $r_{\omega^{-1}(i)}-c_{\omega^{-1}(i)}$ up-elbows, including the up-elbow portions of any bump tiles. This generalizes the proved bound for vexillary permutations to arbitrary permutations; the source gives no resolution of the general case.
source_name: Elena S. Hafner, “Vexillary Grothendieck Polynomials via Bumpless Pipe Dreams”, arXiv:2201.12432 (2022).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.12432

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2022).
